title: How Do Scammers Drain Gift Cards? #Shorts
description:
How do scammers drain a gift card before you even buy it? Thieves take cards off the store rack, scratch or peel the back to copy the number and PIN, then cover it up and hang it back. When you pay and the card goes live, they spend the money online without ever touching the card. Some even swap the barcode so your money loads their card. Before you buy: check the back (stickers on, PIN covered, nothing scratched), keep the receipt and a photo of the card, and remember that anyone asking you to pay in gift cards is a scammer. Source: FTC consumer advice.
